mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% for 3 consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of unemployment rate below 3.5% and federal funds rate above 4.0% indicates an overheating economy with aggressive monetary policy, triggering market correction and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (GDP growth > 2.5% annualized), strong GDP growth (GDPC1) signals continued economic momentum supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances with GDPC1 growth > 2.5% during late-cycle expansion, or correlation with returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates expanding economic activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for PAYEMS trend falls below 0.03 over any 1-year window, or 5-day returns in rising PAYEMS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 3.0% signals a tight labor market with potential wage inflation, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 3.0%, or Rank IC for UNRATE < 3.0% is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) combined with falling industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates weakening economic demand and supply, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term in regression is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100), a decline in industrial production signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 40% of instances with INDPRO < 100 during manufacturing contraction, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
